title: CW-PACK38 2-Bit Header Plus Three 12-Bit Fields
negative_results: a header value exceeding the 2-bit field (0..3) is refused, not truncated
any of the three 12-bit fields exceeding 4095 is refused, not truncated
a wrong number of fields (not exactly three) is refused
negative header or field values are refused
booleans and non-integers are refused (not silently coerced)
a packed word outside the 38-bit range is refused
refuse_as_geographic() always raises: a packed word is never a location

claims.statement: CW-PACK38-1 reversibly packs a 2-bit header and three 12-bit fields (2+36=38 bits) into a single word; encode/decode is an exact round-trip.
The earlier 38-bit candidate is retained as a separate named version; its output is an arithmetic re-expression and never a geographic decode, and it never forces a single pin.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
